compositionRule: At most one permissive policy per role/command/access purpose. No broad role predicate may coexist with a scoped predicate. Sensitive server-only tables have zero browser policies.
columnSecrecyRule: RLS restricts rows, not columns. No safe-projection claim is valid unless an exact column grant or trusted serializer independently limits the returned columns.

trustedContext.tenant: profile row owned by that subject
trustedContext.posEmployee: never inferred from Primary Auth; server function validates actor/session/package
trustedContext.device: registered authority relation, not request body

tables.model: no direct browser policy or object privilege
tables.replacement: one shared trusted Next.js authorization/account context returns only username, full_name, contact_email, phone, tenant_name, branch_name and enumerated ui_capabilities
tables.reason: RLS cannot enforce column secrecy; authority and security columns remain server-only
indexes: unique auth_user_id for trusted server lookup

tables.staleJwtRisk: tenant not sourced from JWT metadata

tables.using: row.tenant_id == trustedTenant(subject) AND row.branch_id IN trustedActiveBranches(subject)

tables.model: no direct browser policy or object privilege
tables.replacement: verified admin GET /api/admin/inventory-movements with trusted server tenant/branch predicates, max page size 50 and max UTC window 366 days
tables.serverGatewayBehavior: may bypass RLS; route predicates and response allowlist are mandatory and RLS is not claimed as server authorization

tables.replacement: bounded lookup RPC plus trusted create/update routes
POS authority functions and safe projection

tables.table: audit_logs, branch_whatsapp_configs, order_number_sequences, customer identity base tables

tables.using: current execution is the exact owner/runtime boundary

profiles.fullAuthorityLookup: server-side only through an exact server gateway/wrapper, never a user-bound authenticated database client, and reused per request/context

inventoryMovements.branchSource: trusted server assigned scope or tenant-constrained requested branch

updateRule: Any future browser update requires a matching SELECT policy, USING over the pre-image, WITH CHECK over the post-image, and immutable tenant/branch/owner fields. No such business write is retained in this target.
performanceRule: Resolve trusted subject→tenant/branches once per statement/request and join on indexed identifiers; never repeat volatile/profile subqueries per row.
postChangeProof: effective permissive OR and restrictive AND expressions
profiles direct Data API and forbidden-column negative tests
inventory base/view direct Data API negative tests
trusted server tenant/branch and bounded-window tests
query plans for retained direct and server reads
